The Town of Clermont, Georgia does hereby impose a temporary moratorium. on all rezoning applications within the Town of Clermont, Georgia, and as to the issuance of all building permits, as to-all permanent signs, including but not lmited to billboards. The term,

“billboards” shall be as defined by said term’s common dictionary definition, and include but is jot limited to all offpremise, permanent, free standing signs typically of a standard, uniform, nationally recognized size which commonly has a sign face of approximately 300 square feet and being a sign face of 10 feet by 30 feet or 12 feet by 25 feet. The temporary moratorium shal] be for a time period of 190 days from the date of passage of this resolution by the Town Council of Clermont, Georgia. The temporary moratorium shall not apply to any other type of development, or to temporary signs erected for the exercise of free speech. Temporary signs shall be easily transportable, or of such a nature that the temporary sign can be readily removed, and shall not have a permanent foundation or support. The Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia acknowledges the possibility that certain signs or applications for signs may have certain vested rights, and possibly would not be subject to this temporary moratorium.

Depending upon the circumstances of the sign or the application, the Town Council will make a

| case-by-case determination, of any vested rights regarding said signs or applications.
